topic: Why 924 Sanad offices being the backbone of Oman business administration deserves better software
format: Open with an Oman market data point or Vision 2040 reference, then connect it to operational reality for SMEs
post:
924 Sanad offices in Oman. And most of the businesses they serve are still tracking work permits in WhatsApp threads.

That's not a criticism — it's just where things are. Labour cards, visa renewals, Omanization filings, WPS payroll. These aren't minor admin tasks. They're legal obligations that touch every hire, every month, every year. And for most SMEs, someone is managing all of it through a combination of memory, group chats, and spreadsheets held together by habit.

Vision 2040 puts SME development and digital infrastructure near the center of Oman's growth story. That's serious policy with real investment behind it. But policy moves faster than operations do. The offices processing day-to-day business admin are still largely manual, and that gap doesn't close on its own.

SmartPRO Hub exists for exactly that space — Sanad office management, PRO workflows, Ministry of Labour filings, WPS payroll, work permit tracking, all in one place. Arabic and English. Priced for businesses that aren't enterprises yet but can't afford to operate like startups forever.

The point isn't to replace the people doing this work. It's to stop making them fight the system every time they need to do something routine.

Oman is building real infrastructure right now. The software running daily business operations should be doing the same.
